messages:
anya: Heads-up — customer signed up and completed email verification but never received the welcome credits. They completed a payment flow right after verify (Apple/redirect). Can payments team check why autogrant didn't kick? customer_id=cus_9876 signup_ts=2101012300 email_country=IE
leo-payments: Thanks. Can you paste the exact event timestamps (signup, email verify, payment callback) and payment method type?
anya: signup=2101012300 email_verified=2101012310 payment_callback=2101012335 payment_method=apple_pay (browser redirect -> wallet card). Customer says the in-wallet card has a US BIN but account locale stayed IE.
payments-bot: autogrant_evaluator: result=DENY user=cus_9876 reason=bin_country_conflict detected_bin_country=US account_country=IE rule=autogrant_bin_check event_id=evt_5543
simon: That log screams BIN-country mismatch. Our autogrant is conservative: if payment info arrives with a bin_country that conflicts with account_country we fail the auto path and mark for manual review — especially when the payment callback is after email verification.
leo-payments: Confirming. Current flow: autogrant happens on post-signup event chain; if the canonical payment info isn't present or is inconsistent by time of grant we revert to manual. ApplePay can pick a wallet card with a different BIN after the initial signup which trips this.
leo-payments: Quick repro steps if anyone wants to test: 1) create account with IE email 2) complete email verify 3) wait ~20s then simulate payment callback with payload {"payment_method":"apple_pay","bin_country":"US"} 4) observe autogrant denied and event evt_5543 in payments logs
anya: I pasted the snippet to the customer so they know it's a safety check, but they want credits ASAP. Can someone manual-grant and note the reason for audit?
eve.ops: Running manual grant now. Using command: `/grant-credits cus_9876 100 --reason "manual: bin_country mismatch after verify"` will log operator.
eve.ops: Grant completed. operator=eve.ops grant_id=grant_9987 amount=100 note="manual - bin mismatch"
payments-bot: grant_processor: grant_id=grant_9987 status=COMPLETED user=cus_9876 credited=100 operator=eve.ops
anya: Verified with customer — credits appeared. They confirmed access to sandbox and new tokens. Closing on customer side. :white_check_mark:
simon: Follow-up: filing eng task to relax autogrant to tolerate delayed payment callbacks when email_verified=true and some heuristics (same IP/geo fuzz) match. tagging @leo-payments for design.
leo-payments: Agreed. I'll open a ticket (PAY-4821) to propose: if email_verified=true and payment arrives within 60s with bin mismatch but same geo/IP, allow soft-autogrant + alert.
anya: Thanks all — manual workaround documented in the ticket thread.
